# AI music video director for Claude Code: your song, cut on the beat

**Your song is measured to the beat, storyboarded, shot on Seedance 2.5, lip-synced and cut on every downbeat.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_b43ffe510e98.webp" alt="Music video shots cut on the beat: a singer in a red patent trench walks a smoky neon alley in the rain, then belts and sings into the lens." width="480"></p>

Directs an AI music video or a song-driven promo end to end on varg, the way the most-watched AI music videos are made: measure the song (beat grid, word timings), pitch the concept, cast and lock character references, storyboard every cut on a downbeat, approve stills before paying for video, generate Seedance 2.5 shots, run a mandatory lip-sync pass, draw lyrics and graphics in code, run review rounds and master for each platform. Use when someone asks for a music video, a clip for my song, a video for a track, a lyric video with AI footage, a singing character, an AI artist or band video, slopcore, or a launch video cut to a song. Not for a one-off generated song or single clip (use varg-ai), shot planning and 3D camera blocking only (use varg-previz), a talking character without music (use varg-character-keynote or varg-podcast-video), or a typography-only lyric video with no generated footage (use a HyperFrames music-to-video skill).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-music-video                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-music-video --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Beat-cut music video MP4 per platform |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$2.10 per 5 s Seedance 2.5 shot at 720p (estimate) |
| Uses | varg API, Seedance 2.5, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5, Sync v3, Lyria 3.5, Demucs, HyperFrames |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Make a music video for my song ./track.wav with one lead character, every cut on a downbeat"
- "I have the lyrics: make the song and a 30-second AI music video for the first chorus"
- "Make an anime-style music video with AI footage for ./song.mp3 and lip-sync the two singing shots"
